artboards.title: The Path — one step per post

annotations.text:
01 and 06 are built on the real avatar and are safe to post.

02 to 05 are NOT. AOV / CAC / LTV and "it's not traffic, it's math" were written for experienced operators, before the avatar was known. A complete beginner working shifts does not know those acronyms and will read them as "not for me". Re-cut them before using.

THREE REPEATABLE FORMATS - refill these, do not redesign them.

THE PATH: one curriculum step per post, numbered. Swap the number, the title and the paragraph. As many posts as the path has steps.

MYTH / TRUTH: kills one objection per post. Swap both lines. Never invent a number in the myth.

REAL TALK: the founder's own story. Swap the quote and the paragraph. Rarest of the three - it loses power if overused.

Suggested rotation: Path, Path, Myth, Path, Real Talk. Teaching carries the week; trust posts punctuate it.

Every format ends on the same DM keyword and the same disclaimer. The repetition is the point - for an audience this heavily targeted by scams, a standing "no income guarantees" reads as a signature, not a legal chore.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.
